opening.argument: The material records a call from someone claiming to represent Microsoft, while the person making the recording says the computer they allowed the caller to access was set up specifically for that purpose. The caller’s instructions to download a file and approve prompts, followed by a demand for a one-time payment to upgrade a certificate, are presented as conduct being documented, not as a request from the creator. The prepared computer and the description of the call establish an investigative demonstration intended to expose and warn about the purported tech-support scam; the record does not establish that anyone paid or lost money.
